intro: IIAS School of Management is in Darjeeling and IISD Kolkata is in Kolkata. This page compares their recorded Hotel Management - Diploma fees, placements, admission routes and campuses for 2026.

IIAS School of Management vs IISD Kolkata is not a single winner. Both are recorded as private institutes. Pick the campus that matches the programme you want, the fee you can pay, and the admission test you will take.

sections.heading: IIAS School of Management vs IISD Kolkata for Hotel Management - Diploma: which is better in 2026

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip application, hostel-only or short-course rows so a registration fee is not treated as tuition.

Our records list ₹80,000 a year as total fees for IIAS School of Management's Diploma in Hotel Operation. Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.
Our records do not hold a quotable Hotel Management - Diploma programme fee for IISD Kolkata on this page. Confirm the current official fee notice before you budget.
If fees are your only filter, confirm the current official circular for the exact programme and batch you will join, because year figures and older rows can understate the real cost.
